items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; do not authorize public beta, full launch, affiliate/advertising use, rights outreach, or notification expansion. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution rights; Woot terms restrict commercial/public use of listings, prices, and derivatives. Legal, security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, privacy/jurisdiction, and any affiliate or advertising use. Next evidence action: complete the existing four legal tasks from repository/configuration evidence, then prepare—but do not send—a counsel-reviewed Woot permission request.

Legal triage: Woot deal and price-history data is blocked pending written permission and field-level rights. User alert rules and sync results are counsel_required because personal-data, retention, deletion, notification-consent, and Slack processor evidence is incomplete. GA4 is conditional for measurement-only use, limited to consent-gated collection with no retargeting or sale, but deployed consent/configuration and jurisdictional review remain evidence_needed. Operational logs and Cloudflare data are counsel_required pending log-field, retention/access, vendor/DPA, incident, and data-subject request evidence. No legal item is closed.

Compliance baseline is technical triage only: 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown across 61 sites, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Do not treat telemetry completeness as legal clearance. Revenue evidence remains limited to the 2026-09-21 Amazon aggregate row: $4.92 commission, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items, unattributed by site. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only where existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved.
